policies.title: Reporting and sourcing
policies.body: Koios separates intake sources from publication references. Feeds and wires provide source material for research; published articles cite the smaller CSL references set that actually supports the story.

policies.title: Fact-checking and citations
policies.body: Published manuscripts must use canonical CSL-shaped references, body citations or links where claims depend on outside material, and no article-level sources field.

policies.title: Copy and search standards
policies.body: A publishable Koios article needs a substantial body, a summary, an SEO term in the first paragraph and a level-two heading, short H2 section labels separated from body prose, tags, categories, and an editorial framing that does not turn imagination into prophecy.

policies.title: Corrections
policies.body: Corrections, clarifications, material updates, and retractions are article metadata. They render on article pages, fold into the public correction register, and must declare or inherit propagation surfaces.

policies.title: Licensing and syndication
policies.body: Koios defaults to CC BY 4.0 with explicit syndication rights for indexing, snippets, large image previews, feeds, Google Search/News/Discover surfaces, and attributed downstream distribution.

policies.title: Privacy and measurement
policies.body: Koios measures publication performance with first-party page path, referrer host, and day only. It records no IP addresses, user agents, cookies, browser fingerprints, or reader identifiers.
